title: `notifications/roots/list_changed`
description: A client notification telling the server its exposed filesystem roots have changed.
question: Does this framework emit the notification when its roots change?
why: It is the only client-to-server change notification in the revision, and 2026-07-28 removed it along with the rest of the roots machinery.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

notes.crewai: CrewAI 1.15.26: the adapter has no roots, so it has nothing to announce; the server received no `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.langchain: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2: roots set through `session_kwargs` are fixed for the session, and the adapter has no way to change them or send the notification; the server received none.
notes.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.1: the adapter has no roots, so it has nothing to announce; the server received no `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.pydantic-ai: Pydantic AI 2.54.0: `MCPToolset` takes `roots` at construction and has no method to change them. The wrapped fastmcp `Client` does (`toolset.client.set_roots`, then `send_roots_list_changed`), and through it the server received the notification.
notes.mastra: Mastra 2.2.0: `@mastra/mcp` documents the deprecated roots capability as unsupported and registers no handler, so it never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`; the server received none.
notes.google_adk: Google ADK 2.11.0: `McpToolset` has no roots API, so the client never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.ms_agent_framework: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.21.0: the adapter declares no roots, so it has nothing to announce; the server received no `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.autogen: AutoGen 0.7.5: No roots support, so the workbench never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.strands: Strands Agents 1.59.0: `MCPClient` has no roots parameter, so it never declares roots or sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): no roots support, so the client never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0: the SDK has no roots API, so it never declares roots and never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.semantic_kernel: Semantic Kernel 1.45.0: no roots are declared and there is no API to change them.
notes.llamaindex: LlamaIndex (llama-index-tools-mcp 0.6.0): `BasicMCPClient` has no roots API, so it never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.pi: Pi (@earendil-works/pi-mcp 1.1.0): the `roots` option answers `roots/list` and declares `roots: {}` without `listChanged`, and `McpClient` has no method that sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`. A caller could send one by hand with `notify()`.
notes.google_adk_js: Google ADK (TypeScript) 2.2.1: `MCPSessionManager.createSession` builds `new Client({name: 'MCPClient', version: '1.0.0'})` with no capabilities and no request handlers, and `MCPToolset` takes no client hooks; with no roots API the notification is never sent.
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: `MCPTools` exposes no roots and no way to change them, so the client never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.haystack: Haystack (mcp-haystack 1.5.2): `MCPClient` builds its `ClientSession(read, write)` with no sampling, elicitation, roots or message callback, and neither the server info nor `MCPToolset` takes one, so the client never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.smolagents: smolagents 1.26.0 (mcpadapt 0.1.20): the client has no roots, so it has nothing to announce; the server received no `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: DSPy takes no roots handler. The server's request is answered only by a `list_roots_callback` registered on the caller's own `mcp.Client`, which DSPy is handed by `Tool.from_mcp_tool` and never configures. DSPy itself offers no route; the caller sends `notifications/roots/list_changed` with `send_roots_list_changed()`.
notes.langchain_js: LangChain.js (@langchain/mcp-adapters 2.0.1): with no roots there is nothing to change, and the client never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.spring_ai: Spring AI 2.0.1: the starter has no roots API. `McpSyncClient.addRoot` and `removeRoot` on the published client bean send `notifications/roots/list_changed` (the server saw 2), so this goes through the underlying SDK client.
notes.beeai: BeeAI Framework 0.1.85: no roots API. notifications/roots/list_changed is sent only on a `ClientSession` the caller builds and hands `MCPTool.from_client`, which BeeAI uses as given; the session BeeAI opens itself for a transport has no callbacks.
notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): with no way to declare roots, the client never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.crewai-native: CrewAI 1.15.26, native `crewai.mcp` client (`Agent(mcps=[...])`, not the `crewai_tools.MCPServerAdapter` row): `MCPClient` declares no roots capability and has no API to change roots, so it never sends `notifications/roots/list_changed`.
notes.google_adk_java: Google ADK (Java) 1.11.0: `McpSessionManager` builds the `McpSyncClient` with empty client capabilities and no roots, and neither `McpToolset` nor `McpTool` takes one, so no `notifications/roots/list_changed` can be sent.
notes.koog: Koog 1.3.0-beta: no Koog API. `Client.removeRoot` / `addRoot` and `sendRootsListChanged` on the Kotlin SDK `Client` send `notifications/roots/list_changed`; the server saw 1.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): mcptoolset has no roots option. `AddRoots` and `RemoveRoots` on the `*mcp.Client` the caller passes as `mcptoolset.Config.Client` send `notifications/roots/list_changed` (the server counted 2), but only by calling go-sdk rather than the toolset.

summary: The cell asks whether the adapter announces a roots change through its own API.
